title: WOS API Initial Case File
description: Immutable source evidence and authorized first-case read. Native Formspec documents retain their owner schema authority.

AcceptedAuthoredArtifact.description: Immutable authored artifact actually used by the accepted filing; never the current active artifact.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact retained raw UTF-8 artifact bytes.

document.description: Exact parsed retained owner-native document. Source validates the kind-specific canonical Formspec schema; no rewritten fields.

AcceptedSignatureVerification.description: Original source verification facts. Acceptance, pseudonymous session custody and full Response hash do not prove civil identity.

status.description: Actual source verifier result; verified requires successful configured verification of the original authored signature.

keyId.description: Actual verification key pin when a key was used.

signedPayloadDigest.description: Original signed-payload digest, distinct from the full accepted Response hash.

details.description: Exact retained source verifier details; not a newly generated legal or identity assertion.

AcceptedAttachmentDescriptor.description: Immutable accepted photo/file association; contains no storage locator, source URL or applicant credential.

attachmentId.description: Opaque identifier allocated by the source and bound to this handoff.

fieldPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer relative to the accepted Response.data value, not the Response root. D1 photo is /photo; a repeated nested photo is /household/0/photo. Preserve the actual traversal pointer with ~0/~1 escaping; no dot-path conversion or /data prefix. Source must resolve Response.data.pointer(fieldPath) to the exact accepted attachment descriptor.

fileName.description: Filename from the exact accepted Response attachment descriptor, frozen at acceptance. This is the name as filed; it does not assert the upload-time filename.

mediaType.description: Retained MIME media type, independently checked before serving bytes.

hash.description: SHA-256 of original attachment bytes, checked on each source read.

AcceptedIntakeEvidence.description: Source-owned immutable accepted evidence returned by the protected service resolver. Native JSON is opaque to WOS code generation, but must pass canonical Formspec validation and cross-field qualification before acceptance.

handoff.description: Exact canonical IntakeHandoff1.0, unchanged, including original session and genuine material-history head. Optional actorRef/subjectRef may be omitted; no invented nulls or new members.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

response.description: Exact full accepted Response, including original signatures, pins and answers; validate maintained full responseHash.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

validationReport.description: Original retained report selected by handoff validationReportRef; never reevaluated at read time.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

definition.description: Exact Definition artifact; kind must be definition and URL/version match Response and handoff.

definitionHash.description: Maintained canonical semantic Definition hash, distinct from raw artifact hash.

displayedLocale.description: Exact recorded Locale; kind locale and URL/version/language agree with accepted Response.displayedLocale. Omit only when inline Definition wording was actually displayed.

artifacts.description: Additional authored artifacts actually used for this accepted rendering; no speculative inventory.

materialHistory.description: Actual retained RespondentLedger material history selected by ledgerHeadRef, with genuine event/session/Response/report association. Does not assert anchoring.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

originalEvaluation.description: Exact original source evaluation receipt (values/validations/etc), retained unchanged. This is not the canonical ValidationReport; canonical report is derived once from that same actual result, clock and pinned Definition through the maintained Formspec builder.

CaseFileRead.description: Authorized staff read of the immutable initial filing and actual WOS identities. This is separate from mutable runtime case state.

caseLedgerId.description: Actual accepted durable case ledger URN.

processId.description: Actual process created for this intake.

tasks.description: Immutable original task inventory from committed intake creation facts. Empty only when those facts establish no tasks were created, including while checks are queued; later tasks require separately authorized task API reads.

intake.description: Immutable initial accepted source snapshot, qualified and durably associated with this case.

IntakeHandoffReceipt.description: Closed transport outcome. Pending is retriable qualification/delivery before runtime acceptance, not a finalized deferred runtime receipt. Identical accepted replay returns the same identities.

oneOf.description: Return after actual case/process acceptance commits. Tasks retain the original creation inventory; queued checks may create human tasks later.

handoffId.description: Original stable source handoff identifier; never regenerated on retry.

tasks.description: Immutable original task inventory from committed intake creation facts. Empty only when those facts establish no tasks were created, never for missing metadata or refused disclosure. Accepted replay preserves this inventory after queued checks create tasks.

oneOf.description: No case identity is asserted for this outcome.
